resources.string: Use Chemex bonded paper sized for your brewer. Place three layers over the spout, rinse with hot water and discard the rinse water. Add medium-coarse coffee and tare the scale. Keep the air channel open.
Wet all grounds with the bloom water and let the bloom finish.
Pour gently to the total water target. Let the level fall between pours and keep it below the rim.
Wait for the coffee bed to drain. Remove the filter, swirl gently and serve using the collar or handle.
